name: Mandeville
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Mandeville, LA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Mandeville, Louisiana for 2026: 7 family events with dates, times and addresses checked on host and tourism listings.
lede: Mandeville celebrates Christmas on the Lake Pontchartrain shore with a Santa parade, the Holiday of Lights on Koop Drive and Old Mandeville's Christmas Past Festival.
celebrates: Mandeville opens December with Winter on the Water, a parade that ends at the Mandeville Trailhead with a festival of Santa photos, crafts, a bell choir and candlelight caroling on December 5. The Holiday of Lights on Koop Drive follows with Santa's Enchanted Forest, free carnival rides and falling snow. Old Mandeville's Christmas Past Festival fills Girod Street on December 12 with Santa, a Kids Zone and a scavenger hunt. Families can also see A Very Merry Grinch Spectacular at 30 by Ninety Theatre or visit the Children's Museum of St. Tammany for its Sugarplum Celebration.
lastyear: The 2026 listings show how long these events have run. Winter on the Water is the 27th annual, so the 2025 festival was the 26th. The Holiday of Lights is its 27th year, and Old Mandeville's Christmas Past Festival is the 22nd annual, which makes last year's the 21st. The parish page lists the Holiday of Lights opening nights as December 4, 5, 11 and 12 this year. These counts come from the tourism and parish listings.
facts: Mandeville was founded in 1834 by the Marigny de Mandeville family of New Orleans and developed early as a lakeside summer resort, according to Louisiana's tourism site. The Mandeville Trailhead Amphitheater hosts the Winter on the Water festival, and the Holiday of Lights tram ride runs along the Tammany Trace on Koop Drive. The Old Mandeville Business Association, a non-profit of local businesses and residents, presents the Christmas Past Festival.
trains: There is no Christmas train ride in Mandeville, but the Holiday of Lights offers a free tram ride along the Tammany Trace through Santa's Enchanted Forest on December 4, 5, 11 and 12. The City of Covington's history page says a branch of the East Louisiana Railroad once connected Covington, Abita Springs and Mandeville. For real train rides, see our Louisiana Christmas train rides guide.
traditions: A parade of Santa and Mrs. Claus to the Mandeville Trailhead, followed by a free festival.
Free lights and a tram ride through Santa's Enchanted Forest on Koop Drive.
Old Mandeville's free street festival with Santa, a Kids Zone and a scavenger hunt.
An evening at the Children's Museum of St. Tammany.
A family holiday show at 30 by Ninety Theatre.
kidfact: The Holiday of Lights has falling Louisiana snow, which the parish calls sneaux, at the entrance.
faq: With the Winter on the Water Parade and Festival at the Trailhead, the Holiday of Lights on Koop Drive and the Christmas Past Festival in Old Mandeville. The Children's Museum of St. Tammany and 30 by Ninety Theatre add an indoor Sugarplum Celebration and a Grinch musical.
Are there free Christmas events in Mandeville?
Yes. Winter on the Water, the Holiday of Lights and the Christmas Past Festival are listed as free.
Where can kids meet Santa in Mandeville?

At Winter on the Water on December 5, the Christmas Past Festival from 10 am to noon on December 12, Santa's Workshop at the Holiday of Lights, and a ticketed Santa photo night at Pontchartrain Yacht Club on December 11.
Is there a train ride in Mandeville?
No, but the Holiday of Lights has a free tram ride on the Tammany Trace on its opening weekends.
Are there Christmas events in Abita Springs?
We found one verified event, Pictures with Santa at Applegator Kids Vintage, which is listed on this page. Abita Springs is folded into Mandeville.

We check every date on the host's own website or an official tourism calendar, and each listing links straight there.
